title: A test says body measurements have no top, so 150 % body fat passes
what: The measurements test checks that any number above 0 is accepted with no upper limit. Body fat goes through the same reading, so a test run stays green while 150 % body fat is saved and drawn on the chart.
expected: A test that types 150 in Body fat and sees the message that body fat must be 100 % or less, with nothing saved.
fix_line: Add a top for body fat and change the test to expect it

title: No test proves weigh-ins and measurements stay private from the gym
what: Only the gym-mate share is checked for body weight. No test checks what the phone sends to the gym or trainers leaves out weigh-ins and measurements, and none checks that removing the sample data keeps the member's own measurements.
expected: A test of what goes to the gym and trainers with weigh-ins and measurements logged, finding neither; and a test that removes the sample data and still sees the member's own entries.
fix_line: Add a test of the gym and trainer copy with body data logged, and one for removing sample data

title: The 'This week so far' card is checked only as numbers, never on screen
what: The week-so-far numbers and words are tested as rules, and the card's title only by reading its code. No test shows the card, taps its top lift, sees the first-week words, or checks it moves after a workout is added or deleted.
expected: A device test that opens Profile with a usual week, sees the card's lines, taps 'Up most' to its exercise, and sees the numbers change after a new and a deleted workout.
fix_line: Add a device test of the week card, including after a new and a deleted workout

title: Ready today is never tested empty, after a deleted workout, or with health data
what: The rest rules are tested and the page's words are seen once. No test sees 'No workouts logged yet' or the read error, checks a deleted workout frees a muscle, or proves sleep and heart data from health apps never change a muscle.
expected: Tests that see the empty and error words, delete a workout and see the muscle ready again, and connect health data and see nothing change.
fix_line: Add tests for the empty, error, deleted-workout and health-data cases

title: The treadmill and bike boxes are tested only as rules, never typed into
what: Which machines get boxes, how a comma or a dot reads and how a set shows in History are tested as rules. No test types into the boxes on a workout, hears the screen reader label, sees a too-high number refused, or clears the speed and sees the incline kept.
expected: A device test that types '8,5' and '6' on a treadmill set, ticks it, sees '8.5 km/h · incline 6%', and tries 45 and sees it refused.
fix_line: Add a device test that types into the treadmill and bike boxes

title: The Counting sheet and its 'this workout only' choice are never opened in a test
what: The column heads and the way a dumbbell weight is counted are tested as rules. No test opens the Counting sheet, checks it is missing on barbell, time or reps-only exercises, or changes counting for one workout and sees other workouts and the trainer's total unchanged.
expected: A device test that opens Counting on a dumbbell exercise, picks a choice for this workout only, and sees other workouts keep theirs.
fix_line: Add a device test of the Counting sheet, for all workouts and for one

title: A muscle tip that fails to add or swap is never tested
what: The tip's add, swap, skip and switch-off paths are run on a phone. No test makes Add or Swap fail and checks the plain message and that the tip stays, and none checks the 'Adding…' and 'Swapping…' states that stop a double tap.
expected: A test where Add fails and the member sees the message with the tip still there, and one that taps Add twice and finds the exercise added once.
fix_line: Add a test for a failed Add or Swap and for a double tap

title: 'Start records fresh' is tested in the database but its words are never shown
what: Starting records fresh and counting all again are well tested on a real database. No test opens the question 'Start records fresh?', sees 'No records since <date> yet · Count all again', or reads the words that promise past workouts stay.
expected: A device test on an exercise page that starts records fresh, sees the line with the date, and taps Count all again.
fix_line: Add a device test of Start records fresh and Count all again
